primary_source_interpretation: The source gives the recipient the return duty, while its legal department or outside legal counsel may maintain a single copy for stated compliance purposes. These effects must not unconditionally inherit one identical actor.
representation_finding: The current one-actor-per-clause bridge loses effect-specific actor scope even though the acquired IR supports separate actors for separate norms. A verifier alone cannot supply the missing interface degree of freedom.

source_witnesses.text: Upon the Disclosing Party’s request, the Receiving Party will promptly return to the Disclosing Party all materials or tangible items containing the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information and all copies thereof; provided, however, Receiving Party’s legal department or outside legal counsel may maintain a single copy of Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information for purposes of regulatory compliance and compliance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
